title: All Tide Up | Royal Destinations
meta_description: New Destination on 30A - Prime Location - Private Pool - Summer Kitchen - Steps to Beach Access - 6,000 sq ft of Living - 7-Bedroom 10-Bath Home, Stunning Gulf Views - Professional Luxurious Decor - All En Suite - Large Family and Friend Vacation Retreat!
description_expanded: Description: All Tide Up by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 8103 East County Highway 30A Details: Commanding a presence in Seacrest, with breathtaking views of the Gulf, All Tide Up is your ideal beach getaway. Just steps away from beach access, this newly built home has been thoughtfully designed to provide a resort-style experience, embodying the essence of coastal living. Upon entering, the private resort-style pool immediately draws you in, inviting you to relax in its crystal-clear waters. Immerse yourself in the peaceful vistas of the Gulf, just a short stroll from the iconic sugar-white sands of 30A. The convenience of beach access allows for a seamless transition from the pristine shoreline to the elegant interiors of this extraordinary home. All Tide Up features six generous king bedrooms, a bunkroom, seven bathrooms, and three powder rooms, providing plenty of space for relaxation and retreat. The expansive Great Room on the third floor, filled with natural light, offers a welcoming ambiance enhanced by its vaulted, tongue-and-groove ceiling. The chef’s kitchen serves as a social centerpiece, equipped with integrated appliances, a large gas range, and two islands adorned with stunning waterfall countertops. Beautiful custom light fixtures and additional bar seating enhance the spacious dining area, comfortably accommodating up to ten guests, creating the perfect setting for cherished moments with family and friends. An elevator connects all three floors for your convenience, ensuring everyone can enjoy the home with ease. The addition of ten bikes allows you to explore nearby restaurants and attractions, making your stay at All Tide Up both enjoyable and effortless. Step outside to the custom pool area, where ample outdoor lounging spaces, an outdoor kitchen, and dining and living areas create a luxurious retreat. All Tide Up is ideally located, just a short bike ride from various dining options and activities, while still providing a tranquil sanctuary. Discover the opulence of All Tide Up—where luxury intertwines with relaxation, and every detail is crafted for your comfort. Home Highlights: - Steps from Public Beach Access - Panoramic Gulf Views - (10) Complimentary Adult Bikes - Chef's Kitchen - Elevator - Outdoor Kitchen and Dining - Private Resort-Style Pool* * Pool heat is available Oct-April for an additional $60/day (pre-tax). * The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. * Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 18 7 Bedrooms / 7 Full Baths / 3 Half Baths First Floor -Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Second Floor -Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Third Floor -Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower -Guest Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub -Guest Bedroom 5: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo -Guest Bedroom 6: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower -Guest Bedroom 7: (2) Twin over Twin Bunks, Private Bathroom with Shower Ease of Convenience to Restaurants and Shopping: -The Big Chill (1 Mile) -Alys Beach (1.7 Miles) -Seacrest Beach (2.3 Miles) -Rosemary Beach (2.4 Miles) -30Avenue (2.9 Miles) -Publix at WaterSound Origins (2.4 Miles) Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
